definitions.signed_amount_cents: Negative outflow/charge; positive income/refund. On transfers/payments the event amount is the originating negative leg; receiving leg is positive.
definitions.spending: Purchases + fees + interest + cash withdrawals + family support - refunds. Category allocations sum to negative event amount; receipt vouchers excluded.
definitions.transfers: Own-account transfers counted once by outgoing magnitude, excluded from spending and income. Card payments separately excluded.
definitions.lines: Transaction/activity rows and receipt debit tender only; headers, item detail, coupons, vouchers, totals and footers are supporting evidence, not activity rows.
definitions.duplicates: Extra non-pending bank/CSV/screenshot representations of the SAME account leg. Receipts are counted separately as receipt matches. Opposite transfer/payment legs, distinct purchases and pending-to-posted transitions are not true duplicates. Assigned to canonical event month.
definitions.receipt_matches: Receipt debit tenders linked to bank events, scored separately from duplicate bank-source copies.
definitions.distinct_purchases: Events sharing distinct_purchase_group are legitimate identical purchases; preserve each event even when date, amount and descriptor match.
definitions.dates: Event date is canonical posted date. Screenshot pending date and CSV date may differ; use event date for monthly totals.
definitions.identifiers: Stable fixture joins only; no permission to auto-match or infer identity. Event/leg IDs are never printed in source documents.
